cardboard.basis: Median of recent lists (1.000-1.800); upper-middle for Jakarta.

e-waste.basis: Midpoint of published per-kg range (5.000-15.000) for small e-waste. Large appliances are per-unit, not per-kg (see sub_types).

glass.basis: DLH Batang figure; recent lists cluster 150-500. Lowest-value recyclable.
sources: DLH Batang / Bank Sampah 'Uwuh Makmur' (see prices-locations-draft.md)

metal.basis: Scrap iron (besi) median. Sub-types differ wildly — the app must offer besi / aluminium / tembaga as sub-types (see sub_types).
sources: Bank Sampah Kenanga, Jakarta Utara (Berita Jakarta, 23 Oct 2026) — https://m.beritajakarta.id/read/156272/tabungan-di-bank-sampah-kenanga-bisa-biayai-pendidikan

organic.basis: Intake price, between the two published figures (Jalatrang 25, Jogja maggot 150). Nearly worthless at intake — the value is in the OUTPUT (compost 700-2.000/kg). Show both numbers, labelled.

sources: Wijaya Kusuma Depok journal table (2025 data, publ. Mar 2026) — https://e-journal.unper.ac.id/index.php/JEC/article/download/2516/1432/13345

plastic.basis: Clean PET bottle benchmark. Recent lists: Jalatrang 2.500, Kendari BSI 3.000-4.000, Sumedang 3.000, Depok 2.500; Jakarta's Kenanga pays 3.000-3.500 via pickup, 4.500 direct drop-off.
sources: Bank Sampah Kenanga, Jakarta Utara (Berita Jakarta, 23 Oct 2026) — https://m.beritajakarta.id/read/156272/tabungan-di-bank-sampah-kenanga-bisa-biayai-pendidikan

caveats: Clean/dry/sorted waste earns 1.5-2x dirty/mixed (PET bersih 2.500-4.500 vs PET kotor 1.500-2.000).
Pickup service pays ~25-30% less than direct drop-off (Kenanga data point).
Prices fluctuate with commodity markets — the app must show a 'last updated' date (Nov 2026) and the source.
method: Median of recent (2025-2026) published bank-sampah price lists, anchored to the two Jakarta data points (Kenanga, Ireka). Historic lists used only as sanity checks. Full per-source tables in prices-locations-draft.md (36 refs).

metal.note: Copper is volatile; aluminium/copper prices are approximate medians from the same source lists.

organic.note: Show intake AND compost-output prices, labelled — a single organic price misleads.

unit: Rp per kg (buy price paid to households)
